# LoadingState

The single loading idiom: skeletons shaped like the content on first load, a slim top line and "Updating…" stamp when refreshing data that is already shown, an…

`SongNodes.LoadingState` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.LoadingState mode="first">…</SongNodes.LoadingState>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.LoadingState" mode="first">…</x-import>
```

## Props (LoadingStateProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` * | `"first" \| "refresh"` | first = nothing to show yet (skeleton); refresh = data stays, slim top line shows. |
| `shape` | `"rows" \| "tiles" \| "custom"` | Shape of the skeleton for first loads, matching the content that will arrive. |
| `count` | `number` | Number of skeleton rows or tiles; match the expected first screen (default 5 rows / 3 tiles). |
| `message` | `string` | What is loading, shown after 1 s: "Loading 1,284 tracks…". |
| `messageDelayMs` | `number` | Delay before the message appears, in ms (default 1000). |
| `updatedAt` | `Date \| string` | Last successful update, shown in the freshness stamp; replaced by "Updating…" while refreshing. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The real content (kept visible during refresh). |
